research_question: Does choosing extra observed interventions specifically to falsify a learned shared causal operator reduce confidently wrong unfamiliar predictions more effectively than matched-budget ordinary active, random observation, or random audit, while retaining accurate within-family transfer?
scope: Novel SOURCE-FREE synthetic 6-bit Boolean causal worlds. All source generators, cohorts, deterministic seed hash prefix 'ckad-distinguish-v1:' and outcomes independent of previously consumed CKAD-SHARED-V2. NO original-world, DTR/CausalGym, protected first-use, owner branch or accepted model edits. Learn shared gate from 16 FIT worlds then freeze.

generator.inputs: Six public binary attributes: five context bits and one action bit5. 64 masks, fixed32 held by SHA256('ckad-distinguish-v1:held:'+mask), disjoint32 effect-action pool.
generator.truth: Per-world response parity(mask & private_linear6) XOR action*AND(context subset gate) XOR private_bias; context gates are positive conjunctions. FIT and TRANSFER share one private gate of size 1 or2, fixed by SHA256('ckad-distinguish-v1:shared-gate'), never passed to policies. Every world has independently derived linear6 and bias.
generator.FIT: 16 seeds 1501..1516, each receives 8 common initial+8 degree2 input-only rank probes =16 distinct fabricated effect calls; learn same 15-gate marginal shared operator prior as qualified V2, no source seed or truth given to model.
generator.TRANSFER: 32 new seeds 1601..1632 under same private gate, independently varying local linear6/bias. Four initial + eight subsequent effect calls per policy, then32 held inputs evaluated after all policies' predictions sealed.
generator.SHIFT: 32 new seeds 1701..1732 with private degree3 context conjunction not in narrow learned gate class, no truth-family label.
generator.CORRUPT: 32 new seeds 1801..1832 with shared true gate, exactly 2 of the initial 4 labels flipped by SHA256 seed+mask before model observation; later observations genuine, no tamper flag.
generator.truth_boundary: Each policy actor has private source state, duplicate/out-of-pool/held early access forbidden. All held outcomes evaluated only after policy readouts frozen. 12 genuinely performed fabricated do effects per arm per evaluation world; no protected source actions.

mechanism.native: Reuse previously qualified NativeSharedOperatorMemory and its frozen global gate support. Narrow candidate program posterior evolves via witnessed input/outcome rows. Broad independent alternative pool of all 25 action-gated conjunctions degree1..3 times 64 XOR linear masks times2 bias (3200). Broader pool is a monitoring counterhypothesis, NOT an oracle truth label or learned new primitive.
mechanism.target: All arms share four initial factual effects. Target first performs 4 ordinary narrow-hypothesis active interventions, then four unique discriminating interventions from remaining pool maximizing the number of broader-model alternatives that disagree with a narrow *unanimous* prediction, with deterministic SHA ties. Target selection only sees the actual previous observed effects, no hidden truth/outcomes, and no future other-arm data.
mechanism.audit_and_readout: Freeze preliminary narrow prediction at 8 observed effects. All four final probes must have an identified prediction from that frozen state and agree with actually observed effects; otherwise all32 target held outputs abstain. After probes, the ordinary narrow model is refitted on all12 effects. Empty/inconsistent posterior also abstains. No threshold or source labels chosen after seeing results. Retain a separately reported broadened-consensus fallback readout for contradictions but never relabel failures as success.
mechanism.ordinary_active: Same global shared prior and four initial outcomes, then eight ordinary candidate-vote splitting interventions without an extra audited check. Same12 source effects.
mechanism.random: Same global shared prior and four initial source effects, then eight distinct SHA-random source actions. Same12 effects.
mechanism.random_audit: Same first four active interventions as target after initial four, then four SHA-random unique audit interventions. Apply EXACT same 4/4 identified/no-contradiction gate. Same12 effects.
mechanism.no_memory_matched: Full original 1920 program bank on EXACT same target's12 observations/actions, no shared prior; no extra effect calls, measures history contribution.
mechanism.strong_independent: Independent symbolic enumerator over all 15 gates×64×2 reimplements target narrow consensus and readout; broad independent degree<=3 enumerator finds exact alternatives without relying on native bitsets. Full prediction parity all64 masks, not only held.
mechanism.cart: Fully fitted conventional sklearn DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=None,min_samples_leaf=1,criterion=gini,random_state=seed) for each arm on same observed rows. Record separate compute and fit time; no extra source effects.
mechanism.cold_retention: Training-world prior and predictions unchanged throughout 96 eval worlds. Exact checkpoint cold restored in another process and cross-platform byte equal. No new knowledge accepted.

frozen_metrics.primary: Across SHIFT+CORRUPT, 64 worlds, target audited wrong held predictions at most 10% of ordinary_active wrong, AND at most 5% errors among target answered in EACH negative cohort, AND at least 30% absolute held coverage on SHIFT OR CORRUPT (to exclude all-abstain success).
frozen_metrics.transfer: On 32 TRANSFER worlds, target >=75% correct held coverage, 0 wrong answers; paired world bootstrap 1000 resamples lower 2.5% bound on target minus random_audit correct coverage >=-0.05 (at most 5pp loss). Report ordinary_active and random on same12 action budget.
frozen_metrics.action_comparison: Target versus random_audit share identical first8 action/effect history and differ only in chosen four final probes. This is primary action-quality contrast. Compare distinct action traces, contradiction detections, admitted models and effect counts. Strong independent symbolic ties are not native exclusive advantage.
frozen_metrics.additional: Track per-world false confidence, acquired knowledge after 12 effects, partial/full bank contradictions, expanded-consensus alternative, held correct/wrong/abstain, active choice CPU/wall, model fit, whole-process wall and memory cost.
frozen_metrics.calibration: Empty or zero answered cohort is not an empirical safety guarantee. No postresult tuning; preserve null and failures.
frozen_metrics.security_and_provenance: No source action until frozen prereg commit, no original source first-use, no modification of owner #1182/main, no new controller, scheduled task, paid model, live model integration, deployment or merge.
frozen_metrics.science: ALWAYS scientific_pass=false: supplied algebraic grammar, artificial deterministic worlds and exact symbolic reference. Final engineering requires focused negatives + complete exact-final root/NKR05/G29 regression on Linux and Windows.
